description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class and related factory functions for managing Web Audio playback, including shared memory buffer management, threading, and interaction with GStreamer for audio processing.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the internal Web Audio player with shared memory buffer management, threading, and GStreamer integration for playback control.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes shared memory mapping and GStreamer Web Audio player.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback via the GStreamer player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback via the GStreamer player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer info and frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Calculates and returns the delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio frames to shared memory and GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles the internal logic of writing frames to shared memory and pipeline.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Writes stored buffers from shared memory to GStreamer.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates the available buffer info after writing data.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a state change.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer Web Audio player with capabilities.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles the timer event for writing data.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Calculates the number of queued frames in shared memory.
